youtube.title: Julius Caesar made one year 445 days long. Then took July 📅 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Julius Caesar fixed the Roman calendar… by making 46 BC a 445-day year. 📅

Comment the reply YOU would've sent Caesar 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: the old Roman calendar had drifted months off the seasons, so Caesar added extra months to 46 BC (the "year of confusion", 445 days) and launched the Julian calendar. The month Quintilis was renamed July in his honor, and later Sextilis became August for Augustus.
